About

Hey, I'm Louise

Welcome to my corner of the internet. The Good Part Weddings aims to help couples plan weddings that feel relaxed, meaningful and genuinely enjoyable to organise.

I've been there: the overwhelm, the endless tabs, the pressure to make every detail perfect. I'm here to take that weight off your shoulders so you can enjoy the bit that matters: being engaged.

The Process

The Planning Experience

Calm, thoughtful planning for weddings that feel like you. From your first message to the moment you say I do, here is how we work together.

1

Get in Touch

Drop me a message with a little about you and your plans. No pressure, no hard sell — just a friendly conversation to see if we are the right fit.

2

Build the Plan

We turn your ideas into a clear, structured plan. Venues, suppliers, timelines and budgets — everything mapped out so nothing gets missed.

3

Handle the Detail

I manage the logistics behind the scenes so you stay present for the moments that matter. Supplier communication, confirmations and problem-solving: all taken care of.

4

Enjoy Your Day

On the day, everything runs as it should. You arrive, you breathe, you enjoy every moment — exactly as it was always meant to be.

Ready to enjoy the planning as much as the day itself?
